description.value: The mech gains two combat feats. Ignore proficiency, Dexterity, and Strength prerequisites. Treat its level, BAB, Acrobatics ranks, and Athletics ranks as its tier plus three. Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization line feats are not allowed, nor are feats that grant extra attacks or actions. If a feat requires RP, the mech can spend 2 PP per RP to use the feat. A mech can consider each upper limb slot as a hand for feats like Add Leverage. Improved Unarmed Strike increases Basic Attack damage to that of a low damage weapon with a level equal to the mech's tier. It also allows attacking with occupied upper limb slots and threatening with them in melee.
